criteria.requirement: Implement confuse.toml_source.TomlSource(filename,default=False,base_for_paths=False,optional=False) as a ConfigSource. Read standard TOML including tables, arrays and dates; keep absolute filename and metadata. load() parses fully before replacing the same source dictionary, removes deleted keys, preserves last valid state on parse/read error and raises ConfigReadError. Optional missing files become empty, other failures remain errors. Configuration.reload must reload TOML and existing YAML without replacing source identities or disturbing in-memory sources. Do not alter YAML parsing.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
